content: For Claude Code skills/agents handling credentials: secrets belong in .env files, never in CLAUDE.md, skill markdown, or committed configs; .env and credential files should be listed in .gitignore and .claudeignore. MCP server configs should reference env vars, not literal tokens. Prefer credential injection at the environment/process level so the agent process/script reads them but the LLM itself never sees plaintext secrets in its context. Skill tool allowlists should be scoped narrowly (specific safe/idempotent commands) rather than blanket-approving a whole tool.
